@graph.name: Salmon Sperm PDRN Facial
@graph.description: Experience Youthful, Radiant Skin with the Salmon Sperm – PDRN Facial in Bangalore A revolutionary anti-aging and skin-repair facial using regenerative biotechn
@graph.howPerformed: After a consultation and skin assessment, your skin is gently cleansed and exfoliated. PDRN serum is then delivered into deeper skin layers through micro-channels made by microneedling or a dermapen. A cooling, calming mask follows, then a hydrating serum, SPF and recovery balm. The whole treatment takes around 45 to 60 minutes.

mainEntity.name: Is the Salmon Sperm PDRN Facial safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDRN has been used in tissue regeneration for years and is biocompatible. Your dermatologist checks your suitability during the consultation before treatment.

mainEntity.name: Will it help with pigmentation and melasma?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can help improve pigmentation, melasma and uneven skin tone, often as part of a combined plan your dermatologist recommends.
Discomfort is minimal. Numbing cream is applied when microneedling is used to deliver the PDRN serum.
Results can last 3–6 months, depending on lifestyle and skincare. Maintenance sessions are recommended every three months.
